stories.headline: Chase Opens 18 Branches in May Amid Multibillion-Dollar Expansion
stories.body: By the end of May, Chase will have opened 18 new branches this month and 52 new branches this year. The bank will have also renovated more than 160 branches since January, it said in a Thursday (May 14) press release. stories.headline: Fed's Barr warns of tradeoffs in shrinking balance sheet
stories.body: Federal Reserve Gov. Michael Barr Thursday warned against efforts to shrink the central bank's balance sheet, saying that effort could undermine financial stability and disrupt money markets.
